results.title: Incoming Oversight Chairman Robert Garcia Statement After Democrats Secure Majority in the U.S. House of Representatives | The U.S. House Committee on Oversight
results.summary:
Summary:
- The press release states that Rep. Robert Garcia, who will become Chairman of the House Oversight Committee, announced after Democrats won the House majority in the 120th Congress.
- Garcia signals intent to pursue investigations into the Trump family, corporate corruption, DHS/ICE abuses, and a probe related to Epstein files coverage.
- The statement includes the phrase “Lawyer up.” and notes his planned focus areas as chair.

If you’re looking for upcoming actions, the release signals:
- Planned investigations by the new Oversight Committee under Garcia on the Trump family, corporate corruption, DHS/ICE abuses, and Epstein-related matters.
- No specific scheduled hearings or dates are provided in this release.

results.title: Incoming Armed Services panel chief vows ‘vigorous oversight’ of Pentagon
results.summary:
Summary:
- Rep. Adam Smith, incoming chair of the House Armed Services Committee, pledges “vigorous oversight” of the Pentagon and the Trump administration beginning January with increased public testimony and reestablishment of an Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee.
- Key topics for potential oversight include U.S.-Israel-Iran policy, military actions in the Caribbean and Latin America, deployment of forces to U.S. cities, and investigations into waste, fraud, and abuse in defense contracts.
- Smith criticizes politicization within the armed forces and proposes restoring the committee’s role as a coequal branch with a strong oversight mandate.
- He also signals reforms toward a more realistic national security posture and defense budgeting, aiming to curb excessive cuts or unsustainable spending.
